notes.title: #3 - Ballotoro is released. What's next?
notes.content:
🚨
So Ballotoro is a short, chaotic game about rolling a ball. It's out now.

It was built in just one month, and while I don’t expect it to sell long-term, I’m genuinely happy to see people playing it.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807080/Ballotoro"][/dynamiclink]

Ballotoro taught me a lot about game development.

It’s simple, messy, and fast — and that’s exactly what I feel "fun".



Before this, I was working on a much bigger project called End Turn.

It had a unique idea, and I pushed "hard" trying to make something grand.

But a year flew by, and I burned out. It stalled.



Now, after finishing Ballotoro, I finally feel like maybe I could return to End Turn —

But this time with a better foundation and a clearer mind

(Actually, I don't know what my brain is doing sometimes.)




What’s next?


Not sure yet. But I’m moving forward.

Thanks for trying out Ballotoro — even a short game means a lot when someone chooses to play it.

Ha, ha… One day.

--

flatcat

notes.title: Ver 0.3.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Enemiy in this game is called Foe

- Foe may come in formation of 5
- Total health is determined by number of turns passed. Distributed fairly
- Player can select which foe is targeted for effects. Select again to deselect
- Wave ends when all foes destroyed
- Adjusted playflow
- Removed kill counter
- Fixed bugs
